elaine: Heads up 1 - baby arrived early, moving my parental leave earlier by 9 days. We have a critical QA pass and a small feature. Any emergency support options?

mike: Congrats! We offer Emergency Family Support (reimburse up to $1k/month) and a Short-Term Backfill Loan (interest-free up to $5k). What
re you estimating?

elaine: Likely a 2.5 week contractor, estimate $2,800. Prefer reimbursement but over $1k so loan?

rana: Yep loan fits. Process: manager signoff email to people-ops with dates, estimate, and a 1-page handoff. People Ops approves; Finance reviews if >$3k. Payroll sets deductions (default 6 months).

elaine: Thanks. Manager will email today and Ian attach a 1-page runbook + deliverables.

payroll-bot: payroll-bot: After approval submit signed agreement to payroll@redwood.com with code STB-LOAN. Payroll will confirm deduction schedule and ID verification requirements.

people-ops-bot: people-ops-bot: Confidentiality reminder
 keep personal leave details private; public reply: "family leave transition support".
